description: This file defines the 'Request' class within the OpenCart framework, handling HTTP request data such as GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER variables. It includes methods for retrieving and sanitizing input data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class encapsulating HTTP request data, providing access to GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER data with sanitization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object by sanitizing and storing the global PHP variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GET parameter by key, with optional type casting.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Retrieves a POST parameter by key, with optional type casting.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Recursively sanitizes input data, trimming and converting special characters to HTML entities.
